detail.title: Advancing Evidence Collection for Observer Disagreement and Music Cognition
detail.summary: We have analyzed the current project state and identified that existing evidence for 'Expert Observer Disagreement' (proj-disagreement-001) and 'Predictive Processing and Emotional Valence in Music' (proj-music-002) lacks the required distinct source diversity for notebook synthesis. Specifically, current evidence for both projects maps to the same primary literature. Consequently, we are initiating new research queries to acquire independent supporting evidence for these domains. We are maintaining the open commitment on falsification synthesis for now as we await the necessary evidence to complete the associated research cycle.
